name: Canva
shortDescription: Online design tool with AI features.
bestFor: Social posts, thumbnails, CVs and flyers, even if you have never designed before
about: Canva is an easy online design tool with thousands of templates. You pick a template, change the text and photos, and download. Its AI features (Magic Studio) can write text, make images, remove backgrounds and resize designs.
It works in the browser and on phones, and the free plan is enough for most personal use.
features: Magic Design: makes designs from a prompt
Magic Resize to change a design for other platforms (Pro)

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at canva.com or install the app.

howToUse.title: Search for a template
howToUse.text: Type what you are making, such as "YouTube thumbnail" or "CV", and choose a template.

howToUse.title: Change the content
howToUse.text: Click text to edit it, drag in your own photos, and change colours.

howToUse.title: Use AI if needed
howToUse.text: Open Magic Studio to generate an image, write text or remove a background.

howToUse.title: Download or share
howToUse.text: Click Share > Download and choose PNG for images or PDF for print.

tips: Set up your brand colours and fonts once so every design matches.
Download PDF Print for anything you will print at a shop.
limitations: Many AI features and premium templates need Canva Pro.
Popular templates are used by many people, so change them to stand out.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Microsoft Designer
shortDescription: Free AI design app from Microsoft for posts, cards and images.
bestFor: Quick free designs and AI images with just a Microsoft account
about: Microsoft Designer makes designs and images from a description. Type what you need, such as a birthday card or an Instagram post, and it creates several ready designs you can edit.
It also has tools to remove backgrounds, restyle photos and make stickers and emojis.
features: Templates for cards, posts and more

howToUse.title: Sign in
howToUse.text: Go to designer.microsoft.com and sign in with a free Microsoft account.

howToUse.title: Describe your design
howToUse.text: Type what you want, for example "wedding invitation, gold and white, Mehndi on 12 December".

howToUse.title: Pick one
howToUse.text: Choose the design you like from the results.

howToUse.title: Edit and download
howToUse.text: Change text and pictures, then download.

tips: Put the exact words you want in your prompt.
It is a quick option; for full control use Canva.
limitations: The free plan has a limited number of AI uses.
Fewer templates and controls than Canva.
freePlanDetails: Free with a Microsoft account, with limited AI uses.
cheapestPaidPlan: More AI uses with Microsoft 365 Personal — $9.99/month

name: remove.bg
shortDescription: Removes the background from any photo in seconds.
bestFor: Removing photo backgrounds in one click, for products and profile pictures
about: remove.bg does one job very well: upload a photo and it removes the background automatically, usually in a few seconds, even around hair.
It is popular with online shops for product photos, and for passport-style or profile pictures.
useCases: Product photos with a white background
features: Add a colour or new background
Desktop app and API for batch work
Works with people, products, animals and cars

howToUse.title: Open the website
howToUse.text: Go to remove.bg. No account is needed to try it.

howToUse.title: Upload a photo
howToUse.text: Click Upload Image or paste a picture.

howToUse.title: Edit and download
howToUse.text: Add a background colour if you want, then download.

tips: Photos with a clear subject and good light give the cleanest cut-out.
Canva Pro and phone galleries also have background removal if you already have them.
pricingNote: US prices. One credit is one full-resolution image. Unused credits roll over up to a limit.
